name: Podrig's Order
summary: In Silverpine, Podrig's Order asks the Undercity for weapons to arm the Sepulcher.

sections.title: Arming the Sepulcher
sections.body: Deathguard Podrig found the Sepulcher's stores mostly adequate after Executor Hadrec ordered an inventory. Yet replacement weapons were running desperately low. His dispatch names the blades and arms needed by the Deathguards holding the outpost in Silverpine Forest. The Scourge, feral beasts, and other dangers threaten the frontier.

sections.title: Dispatch via Bat Handler
sections.body: The order is addressed to Gordon Wendham, a weapon dealer in the Undercity's Trade Quarter. Silverpine's damp crypts make forging weapons difficult. Couriers take the document to bat master Karos Razok, so Forsaken flight paths can speed the shipment from the capital.

faq.q: What is written in Podrig's Order?
faq.answer: Podrig's Order lists replacement weapons for Deathguards at the Sepulcher. Their arms have been lost or broken in the field.
Deathguard Podrig wrote the order at Executor Hadrec's direction. He did so after an inventory of the Sepulcher's armory.
Gordon Wendham, a weapon dealer in the Undercity's Trade Quarter, is meant to receive the order.

faq.q: Why does the Sepulcher need new weapons?
faq.answer: Skirmishes with the Scourge and other hostile forces in Silverpine often leave the Deathguards' equipment broken or lost. They need replacement weapons.

angles.text: As an Undead, you can see how the Undercity supplies outposts like the Sepulcher. That keeps the Dark Lady's soldiers armed against the Scourge.
As a blacksmith, you know forged weapons are vital on the front lines. Combat continually drains a garrison's supplies.
